note.zh: 通过后15天，全体成员将收到关于自愿迁居失业者的通知；违规成员（分层经济生活水准或奴役）立即收到通知。
note.en: After it passes, all members are told 15 days later of voluntary resettlement for the unemployed; members in breach (Stratified Economy or slavery) are told at once.

scope.zh: 决议“超越自我”：福利窗口（10010）与违规窗口（10210）。
scope.en: The resolution "Greater Than Ourselves": the benefit window (10010) and the breach window (10210).
